notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on War Elemental.
description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing War Elemental to become a Goblin until end of turn.
Put a counter on War Elemental.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as War Elemental is a Goblin due to Trickery Charm, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
